title: ECF Coordinate
description: An ECF Coordinate: the ordered pair (Domain, Stage). 7 x 7 = 49 coordinates; each is identified by its ordered pair, not by any display label (CR-ECF-005).

identifier.description: Optional canonical identifier of the form 'ecf:<domain-identifier>.<stage-identifier>' using lowerCamelCase labels. When present, must match domain and stage.

label.description: Optional human-readable label of the form '<Domain Display> x <Stage Display>'.

version.description: Optional ECF specification version that defines the coordinate.
